title: Journal v2: schema-validated, indexed, replayable event log
summary: The journal stops being a loose JSONL buffer and becomes a versioned, schema-validated event log. `journal.rs` is split into five modules: `event.rs` (the envelope, actor, cost and ten payload types), `event.schema.json` (the draft 2020-12 contract every event must satisfy), `schema.rs` (the compiled validator), `hash.rs` (the chain hash plus a new replay digest over decision fields only), `index.rs` (a per-work-item run index under a file lock) and `reader.rs` (a full replay that refuses a broken chain). The buffer directory becomes `runs/`, events gain a work item, a change, a typed actor and a cost, and a run-complete event must name the current head hash and closes the run.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs the tagged moon tasks and writes one verification event per task plus one checkpoint-complete event. Now builds an `Actor::system("osf")` instead of passing a bare string, and fills the new `check_type` and `summary` fields with `None`.

nodes.label: Review run
nodes.subtitle: review answers and decision
nodes.summary: Writes one review-answer event per judged lens and one review-decision event for the whole review. Its two `journal.append` calls now pass `&Actor::system(ACTOR)`; the payload types themselves are unchanged.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens `<state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl`, refuses a run id that is not a safe single path component, and appends one event per line. `append_draft` validates the serialised event against the schema, checks a run-complete event's head hash against the current chain head, records the run in the work-item index before the first line lands, and refuses any event after run-complete.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: Event, Actor, Cost, Payload
nodes.summary: The envelope plus ten payload types: run-started, verification, review, finding, state-change, run-complete, attention, checkpoint-complete, review-answer, review-decision. Adds `work_item`, `change`, a typed `Actor` (harness, person, system), an optional `Cost`, and typed `EvidenceGrade`, `Severity`, `WorkItemState`, `BlockedCause` and `RunOutcome` enums.

nodes.label: Hash chain and replay digest
nodes.subtitle: event_hash, ReplayDigest
nodes.summary: `event_hash` is SHA-256 over the previous hash, a newline, and the canonical JSON of payload, work item, change, actor and cost. `ReplayDigest` is a second, streaming SHA-256 over each event's decision line, which drops timings, cache outcomes, cost, run ids, transcripts and the branch name.

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.subtitle: event.schema.json
nodes.summary: A draft 2020-12 schema for one event envelope: required fields, the ten event types, per-type payload shapes, hash and work-item patterns, and conditional rules such as a harness actor needing a model and a blocked state change needing a cause.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema::validate
nodes.summary: Compiles the embedded schema once per process into a `jsonschema::Validator` and returns one string per problem, each naming the JSON path. The writer calls it on every event before writing a byte.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: record_run, runs_for_work_item
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item under `<state_dir>/index`, named by the SHA-256 hex of the work item id, listing that item's run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temporary file renamed over the target while an `fs4` file lock is held, so concurrent writers lose no run.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: read_run
nodes.summary: Reads a run back line by line, checking the schema, the run id, the previous hash, the recomputed hash and a run-complete event's head hash. Any failure returns that line's error and no events at all, so a caller never sees a partial chain.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: The per-run journal file, moved from `<state_dir>/buffer` to `<state_dir>/runs`. Each run is its own hash chain starting from genesis; a file that already holds events is refused rather than resumed.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <sha256(work_item)>.json
nodes.summary: The per-work-item run index, created only when a journal carries a work item. A missing index reads as an empty list; a malformed one, or one naming another work item, is an error rather than a silent replacement.

nodes.label: Decision 0005
nodes.subtitle: the factory domain model
nodes.summary: Amended to add the `system` actor kind, to name the review-answer and review-decision event types, and to say the replay digest, not the chain hash, is what proves a replay.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.summary: The checkpoint-evidence artifact now uploads `$OSF_STATE_DIR/runs` instead of `$OSF_STATE_DIR/buffer`, so the journal files the job produces are still collected.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner appends verification and checkpoint-complete events through the writer, now with a typed system actor.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The review run appends review-answer and review-decision events through the same writer.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every event is serialised to JSON and validated against the schema before any byte is written; an invalid event leaves the file and the chain head unchanged.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer computes the next link from the previous hash, the payload, the work item, the change, the actor and the cost.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event of a run records that run in its work item's index before the journal line is written; a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line per event
edges.summary: The event lands as one JSON line with a trailing newline under `runs/`, and the chain head advances only after the write succeeds.

edges.label: atomic rename under lock
edges.summary: The index is written through a temporary file renamed over the target while an `fs4` lock is held, so a reader never sees a half-written index.

edges.label: read_run(run)
edges.summary: The reader reads the run's file back and checks every line and every link before returning any event.

edges.label: validate(line)
edges.summary: Each line is validated against the same schema the writer used, so a schema-invalid line is refused even when its hash is correct.

edges.label: event_hash + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: The reader recomputes each event's chain hash and accumulates the replay digest over the decision fields.
The writer builds `Event` values from the event model and serialises them with serde.
The validator embeds the schema file at compile time and compiles it once per process.
The payload types, actor kinds, evidence grades and lifecycle states are the domain model decision 0005 defines.

edges.label: artifact upload
edges.summary: The CI checkpoint job uploads the `runs` directory as its evidence artifact.

steps.heading: The journal grew up
steps.body: One module became six, and the buffer became a validated, indexed run log.

steps.heading: Every event is validated
steps.body: The writer serialises the event and refuses it before writing if the schema disagrees.

steps.heading: The run is indexed first
steps.body: A work item's index records the run before the first journal line lands.

steps.heading: A replay proves itself
steps.body: The reader checks every link and accumulates a digest over decisions only.
